# Bunny's Structures
This datapack adds various vanilla friendly structures to Minecraft that fit well within the game.

# Structures


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

| Structure | Details |
| --------- | ------- |
| Huts | Contains 1 villager, a bed, and a workstation of some sort |
| Towers | Contain 3 floors, each with a greater difficulty than the previous |

</details>
